LANDED — Gerrit 1685 = commit 3c1972e9c0, merged 2026-08-12 22:49 UTC. LLM-Review +1, Verified +1 (run 31646872898 SUCCESS), submitted with a plain Gerrit Submit.

Evidence:
- AC1: live_llm_ready(required_provider) requires the arm's configured_provider() to match the pinned provider AND that provider's credential. Rendered skip on a mismatched arm: "no live LLM: this module pins a 'bedrock' model, but the configured arm resolves 'openai' — that arm cannot cover it, so it runs on the 'bedrock' arm instead". Both providers named; visible, not silent.
- AC2: 0707 derives _PINNED_PROVIDER from _MODEL itself (verified on merged main, lines 36-38), so pin and gate cannot drift; the module still collects 2 tests. The seven arm-following modules are untouched — live_llm_ready() with no argument and the module-level skip_without_live_llm are unchanged.
- AC3: three tests added to tests/unit/test_ci_provider_matrix.py — not ready on a mismatched arm (with the skip reason naming both providers), still ready on its own arm (so the gate is not a blanket disable), and a structural guard that any module pinning a provider must ask the probe about it. The structural guard was RED/GREEN verified: reverting only 0707's sentinel to the bare call makes it fail with the intended message, restoring it makes it pass. Option (b) rejection recorded in the previous comment and in the description.

Gates: make lint exit 0, make typecheck exit 0, full unit suite 9769 passed / 42 skipped (worktree venv).

Note: the review bot reported '2 advisory finding(s) (non-blocking)' but published only the count — no inline or robot comments exist on 1685, so the finding text is not retrievable from Gerrit. Not actioned; the gate is +1 and advisory findings are non-blocking by design. If those findings matter, they need the reviewer to publish their bodies.
